description: Robinhood Chain KOL first touches — the GLOBALLY earliest buy by ANY tracked KOL per token (the discovery / early-entry signal), newest first. Each event carries eth_amount, tx_hash, token_age_minutes at the touch, MC + price at the first buy, current and peak MC, and the first_kol block. Cursor back with next_before. Tier: BASIC, but limit is clamped to 20 below PRO and the KOL's evm_address is returned only on ULTRA/BUSINESS (name + twitter_url always).

before.description: Cursor — only first touches strictly older than this (ISO 8601 with offset). Pass next_before to page back.

launchpad.description: Filter by launchpad: pons, flap, clanker, hood.fun, noxa, virtuals

limit.description: Number of events (1-100; clamped to 20 on BASIC)

max_mc_usd.description: Maximum market cap at the first buy — must be >= min_mc_usd

min_eth.description: Minimum size of the first buy in ETH

min_mc_usd.description: Minimum market cap at the first buy

since.description: Only first touches strictly newer than this (ISO 8601 with offset)

token_age_max_min.description: Only tokens younger than N minutes at the time of the first touch

name: rhc_kol_first_touches
